singleNote: 4D3N RM 240/pax · 5D4N RM 320/pax (rate card ARBA — katalog tulis quoted upon request)
intro: Isi pax dan tarikh berlepas / balik — panjang trip dan semua surcharge dikira sendiri dan terus masuk dalam harga per pax. Kadar accommodation, meal dan aktiviti mengikut Rate Card Simple Customisation Phu Quoc. Tiada peak season surcharge untuk Phu Quoc — boleh travel sepanjang tahun. Blackout: Chinese New Year 2027 (17–18 Feb 2027). CNY 2026 (16–22 Feb 2026) masih boleh booking, tetapi kedai souvenir banyak tutup — set expectation customer. Perhatian: rate card tiada kadar transport untuk hari tambahan, jadi hari tambahan akan bertanda kadar belum diisi — minta harga operator.

validity: Prices follow the PT Phu Quoc 4D3N and 5D4N 2026 v3 catalogues dated 11 March 2026, valid for travel until 31 December 2026. Departures in January and February 2027 carry the 2027 travel date surcharge. This quotation is valid for 24 hours after submission. Itinerary, flight, price and quotation are subject to change. Final itinerary and hotel arrangements are confirmed 14 days before the trip. Free activities are not exchangeable for other activities, vouchers or cash. Blockout date: 17 - 18 February 2027 (Chinese New Year).
